name: Laya

identity.architecture: ModernBERT-large encoder (421M, English) or mmBERT-base (322M, multilingual) plus a 2-layer decision head; one [MASK] marker per option

serving.concurrency_note: Refuses work past 16 concurrent requests by default (HTTP 503); one inference at a time.

typed._note: the laya-typed-decisions checkpoint is fine-tuned on the typed-decisions train split; the base checkpoint is not

exposure_note: Only the typed-decisions relation is documented; the other suites have not been audited against Laya's training data.
